text.en: Pet owners in Riverdale commend the doctors and support team for their warmth, patience, and attentive care. Clients frequently mention Dr. Song, Dr. Chan, and administrative staff like Crystal for creating a welcoming atmosphere and listening attentively to concerns. Aside from one review where staff struggled to handle a fearful dog, feedback regarding clinical teamwork is consistently warm.

Reviewers report successful medical outcomes for ear infections, skin allergies, and wound care, noting that pets experienced rapid relief and visible recovery. Clients praise the thorough diagnostic assessments for chronic conditions. However, one owner was dissatisfied when the veterinary team declined to examine an anxious dog without owner-assisted muzzling, leaving the medical issue unaddressed.

title.en: Clear consultations with occasional billing surprises

text.en: Clients appreciate the clinic's clear medical explanations and attentive follow-up calls after treatment. Doctors outline health plans and provide diagnostic estimates before procedures begin. Nevertheless, some reviewers note communication lapses regarding promotional discounts and unexpected medical waste fees, expressing disappointment when final invoices differed from initial quotes.

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that scheduling appointments online is straightforward, with slots often available within a couple of days.

q.en: Are owners permitted in the exam room with their pets?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report being allowed to accompany their cats and dogs into examination rooms during consultations.

q.en: What medical services does the clinic provide?

a.en: The hospital offers wellness exams, vaccinations, dental procedures, soft-tissue surgery, and diagnostics for dogs and cats.

q.en: Where is Broadway Animal Hospital of Riverdale located?

a.en: The practice is located at 5664 Broadway in the Riverdale neighborhood of the Bronx.
